messages:
cara: Hi team — kicking off Day 0 for the MicroVolt joint perf run. Goal: validate throughput @ 16/32k context, and get a perf/W baseline across our 4 model sizes. Primary outputs: CSV of p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and power-normalized tokens/sec.

Ana (MicroVolt): excited to be working with you all! quick Q: do you want us to run on our stock kernel or your tuned image?

cara: Prefer stock kernel first (baseline), then one tuned pass. We'll coordinate kernel patches later. baseline run should use the open-telemetry image we shared.

ivan (Infra@MicroVolt): got the image link, confirming we have power hooks ready (RAPL + rack PDUs). will verify meter sampling rate.

devon: FYI infra note — please ensure PDU sampling >= 1Hz. otherwise power averaging will be noisy for short runs. Also we need the runner to emit KV cache hit stats.

Ana (MicroVolt): ok for 1Hz. can you share the runner command and env config we'll use?

cara: dropping the canonical run below — use this for all baseline runs so outputs are comparable.

cara: ```bash
# microbench runner (canonical)
./rw-bench run --model redwood/13b --seq 16384 --batch 1 --iter 100 --telemetry-url https://telemetry.redwood.ai/hook/mv-2026 --emit-kv --power-sink rafp
```

cara: The runner emits JSON lines; we'll have a parser in the repo to normalize fields. Link: https://redwood.internal/bench/tools (private).

marcus: Suggestion: add a warmup of 10 iters and capture one long-run of 1k iterations for throughput steadiness. keeps p50 stable.

devon: +1 on warmup. Also: add env var RW_BATCHER=continuous to mimic hosted batching, else results will be overly optimistic.

Ana (MicroVolt): noted. we'll run stock kernel + rw-batcher=none, then tuned kernel + continuous. Plan: Friday baseline, Monday tuned. Is that timeline ok?

sasha: Timeline looks good from partnerships side. We should plan a short public-facing slide deck for the joint announcement if numbers look compelling. can engineering produce a short 2-slide summary after tuned run?

cara: Yes — if tuned run shows >=10% perf/W improvement at target throughput, we greenlight a co-branded announcement draft. Marcus or Devon can prep the slides (high-level).

ivan (Infra@MicroVolt): Quick question on success metrics: is the perf/W calc tokens/sec divided by average watts during steady-state? or something fancier?

devon: Average steady-state watts (exclude warmup and cool-down windows) and tokens/sec averaged across same window. We'll produce both instantaneous and windowed aggregates.

bench-bot: Reminder: attach run metadata in our schema. Required fields: model, seq, batch, kernel-version, image-sha, pdu-id, telemetry-id. Missing fields will fail ingestion.

Ana (MicroVolt): thanks bench-bot. We'll include kernel-version and image-sha in run metadata. Where to upload raw PDUs?

cara: Drop raw PDU CSVs to the secure bucket: s3://redwood-partner-runs/microvolt/day0/ (we'll share presigned URLs). Please name files like pdu-<node>-<ts>.csv.

marcus: Also please capture dmesg + perf top snapshot for tuned run. Kernel regressions are subtle.

Ana (MicroVolt): will do. one more: are we running single-GPU instances or multi-GPU with model sharding?

cara: Start single-GPU per model size. If we hit memory limits, we'll coordinate a standard 2x-GPU split config. Document any sharding configs in the metadata.

ivan (Infra@MicroVolt): ack. We'll run nightly smoke tests with the canonical runner and report failures to this thread.

sasha: I'll schedule a sync next Tuesday 10am PT to review initial baseline CSVs and decide go/no-go for announcement. Calendar invite coming.

Ana (MicroVolt): perfect — thanks all. We'll post first baseline CSVs here once upload completes. :white_check_mark:

cara: one last note — for tuned kernel we may request a few small patches (fio + numa tweaks). we'll open a short PR on your kernel tree and mark it experimental.

ivan (Infra@MicroVolt): fine with that, but please flag any patch that touches thermal governors. ops will need to sign off.

cara: absolutely. ops signoff required for thermal changes.

marcus: logging checklist for the run (copyable):
- run_id
- model
- seq_len
- batch_size
- kernel_version
- image_sha
- pdu_csv_path
- cpu_freq_gov
- rw_batcher
- telemetry_id

Ana (MicroVolt): copying checklist. thanks Marcus.

cara: Thanks everyone — looking forward to Day 0. will follow up with presigns and the canonical parser script in ~2 hours. :rocket:
